scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:setup: test -f .env || (echo 'Missing .env — copy it first: cp .env.example .env' && exit 1); docker compose up -d && until docker compose exec -T db pg_isready -U postgres -q; do sleep 1; done; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; npm run push --workspace @workspace/db
